facts.text: The St. Regis Amman is set in the 5th Circle area of Amman.
facts.excerpt: Welcome to The St. Regis Amman, set in the prestigious 5th Circle

facts.text: The hotel's address is 5th Circle, Shafiq Al Hayek Street, Amman.
facts.excerpt: 5th Circle, Shafiq Al Hayek Street, Amman, Jordan, 11185

facts.text: Segreta is tucked within an indoor garden and serves Italian-led cuisine alongside French and Californian classics.
facts.excerpt: Tucked within an indoor garden at The St. Regis Amman, this intimate Jordan, Amman, restaurant serves Italian-led cuisine alongside French and Californian classics

facts.text: The St. Regis Bar sits behind a 24k gold mural and serves craft cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Behind a 24k gold mural, the St. Regis Bar Amman brings world-class mixology and craft cocktails

facts.text: The hotel's local take on the Bloody Mary is the Jameed Mary, with savory notes echoing Bedouin tradition.
facts.excerpt: Experience the Jameed Mary, our local twist on the classic cocktail. Immerse yourself in Jordanian heritage with savory notes echoing Bedouin tradition.

facts.text: Zenith is a rooftop restaurant and outdoor lounge with panoramic city views.
facts.excerpt: Elevate your experience at our rooftop restaurant and outdoor lounge in Amman, where panoramic city views create the perfect backdrop for dining.

facts.text: Tamara serves mezze, Jordanian specialties and grilled meats, indoors or on the terrace by the pool.
facts.excerpt: From authentic mezze and Jordanian specialties to premium grilled meats, Tamara offers one of the finest Levantine dining experiences in Amman. Enjoy lunch or dinner in a modern indoor space or on the terrace by the pool

facts.text: Mercado is reserved for in-house guests and serves an international breakfast buffet with live cooking stations.
facts.excerpt: Reserved for in-house guests, Mercado opens each morning with an international breakfast buffet in Amman, featuring live cooking stations

facts.text: Deluxe Rooms use earthy tones with rose and orange details that recall the landscapes of Wadi Rum.
facts.excerpt: Floor to ceiling windows overlooking the city, earthy tones and signature details of rose and orange colors link you back to the picturesque landscapes of Wadi Rum.

facts.text: Rooms have Frette linens and the St. Regis Signature Bed.
facts.excerpt: Experience restful nights with premium Frette linens and the exclusive St. Regis Signature Bed

facts.text: Every room includes a marble bathroom.
facts.excerpt: Every room includes a beautifully decorated marble bathroom

facts.text: The Royal Suite, on the high floors, has a private balcony with skyline views, a full kitchen and three bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: Perched on the high floors, it boasts a private balcony with skyline views, a full kitchen, and three bathrooms.

facts.text: The John Jacob Astor Suite's design is inspired by St. Regis founder John Jacob Astor.
facts.excerpt: The founder of The St. Regis, John Jacob Astor, renowned for his relentless pursuit of excellence and commitment to perfecting every detail, inspires this suite

facts.text: The St. Regis Spa offers Dead Sea treatments, a couples suite and a Thermal Suite with sauna, steam room and jacuzzi.
facts.excerpt: the St. Regis hotel spa in Amman offers signature massages, facials, and Dead Sea treatments. Retreat to the couples suite or pre-book the Thermal Suite with sauna, steam room, and jacuzzi.

facts.text: Guests can reach an E-Butler through a live WhatsApp chat.
facts.excerpt: Through a live WhatsApp Chat, our E-Butler awaits your needs.

facts.text: Butlers offer complimentary pressing for up to two garments.
facts.excerpt: enjoy complimentary pressing for up to two garments.

facts.text: The hotel has an outdoor pool.
facts.excerpt: Yes, The St. Regis Amman has one Outdoor pool on-site for hotel guests.

facts.text: Self-parking is not available; valet parking is provided for all guests.
facts.excerpt: Kindly note that self-parking is not available. Valet parking service is exclusively provided for all guests.

facts.text: Valet parking is complimentary for guests.
facts.excerpt: Valet parking is complimentary for guests.

facts.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: Queen Alia International Airport is about 35.2 km from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: AMM is located approximately 35.2 KM from the hotel.

facts.text: The District, on the hotel's P2 floor, is a collection of shops, including a salon and casual bites.
facts.excerpt: Located on the P2 Floor at The St. Regis Amman and managed by Eagle Hills, The District is your go-to destination for a curated selection of shops

facts.text: The hotel performs the St. Regis Champagne Sabrage ritual.
facts.excerpt: Experience the legendary St. Regis tradition of Champagne Sabrage

facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The St. Regis Amman.

facts.text: The 2-bedroom suite has a fully equipped kitchenette and a private balcony with city views.
facts.excerpt: utilize the fully equipped kitchenette, and enjoy the private balcony with breathtaking city views

facts.text: The Tea Lounge serves fine teas, light refreshments and afternoon tea.
facts.excerpt: the Tea Lounge offers fine teas, light refreshments, and afternoon tea in a refined, relaxed setting

facts.text: Amid the regional situation in the Middle East, the hotel states it remains open and operational.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel remains open and operational and our teams are focused on supporting our guests at this time.

facts.text: The hotel is Green Key certified.
facts.excerpt: The Green Key Certified
